extensions.sourceOfTruth: packages/theme/src/tokens.ts (CSS variables var(--dn-*); dark on :root, light on [data-theme="light"])

title.purpose: Dialog headings and the empty-board title.

body.purpose: App default and note text; note headings scale in em (1.35 / 1.18 / 1.05).

label.purpose: Menu items, form labels, panel text.

caption.purpose: Label chips, icon-button labels, sync status, shortcut hints.

micro.purpose: Toolbar labels under icons, tags, sticker footer.

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: Fetch palette; the login card uses 0 20px 50px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.25).

shadows.name: swatch-ring
shadows.purpose: Selected colour swatch: gap ring, not a shadow.

shadows.name: sticker
shadows.purpose: Hard offset shadow under placed stickers.

motion.name: hover
motion.purpose: Hover background and colour on buttons, tools, menu rows.

motion.name: pop-in
motion.purpose: Selection bar, fetch palette, menus appearing.

motion.name: snap
motion.purpose: Snap-to-grid glide while dragging or resizing.

motion.name: sheet
motion.purpose: Phone sheets, docked selection bar and phone toast (200–240ms): fast settle, no overshoot.

motion.name: dog-moment
motion.purpose: Small overshoot reserved for playful pickups: board tile hover, phone dock add button.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one gold action per view: save, share, sign in.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font: 600 14px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; padding: 9px 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--dn-accent); color: var(--dn-accent-text); cursor: pointer; transition: filter 120ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--dn-selection); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: var(--dn-card-hover); color: var(--dn-text-muted); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--dn-border); cursor: default; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Ghost control in the top bar and panels; muted at rest, filled on hover, gold when on.
components.css: .ds-icon-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 32px; min-width: 32px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--dn-text-muted); font: 14px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms, color 120ms; } .ds-icon-btn:hover { background: var(--dn-card-hover); color: var(--dn-text); } .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--dn-selection); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-icon-btn-label { font-size: 12px; }

components.name: Toolbar Tool
components.description: A 48px tile in the left toolbar: icon over an 11px label; gold icon when active.
components.css: .ds-toolbar { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; width: 76px; padding: 8px 6px; background: var(--dn-panel); border-right: 1px solid var(--dn-border); } .ds-tool { min-height: 48px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 3px; padding: 7px 2px 6px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: var(--dn-text-muted); font: 11px/1.15 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms, color 120ms, transform 120ms; } .ds-tool:hover { background: var(--dn-card-hover); color: var(--dn-text); } .ds-tool:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-tool:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--dn-selection); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tool-active { background: var(--dn-card-hover); color: var(--dn-accent); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form field on entry screens and dialogs: floor-coloured well, selection-coloured focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 4px; font: 13px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; color: var(--dn-text-muted); } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 9px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--dn-border); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--dn-bg); color: var(--dn-text); font: 14px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--dn-selection); outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Note Card
components.description: A note on the canvas: flat, 6px corners, swatch-coloured when chosen, gold outline when selected.
components.html:
Walk route

Park loop, then the river path.

errands
Treats to buy

Peanut butter, chews.
components.css: .ds-card { display: inline-block; vertical-align: top; width: 200px; margin: 8px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--dn-card); color: var(--dn-text); font: 14px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-card p { margin: 4px 0 8px; } .ds-card-selected { outline: 2px solid var(--dn-selection); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-card-gold { background: var(--dn-card-gold-bg); color: var(--dn-card-gold-text); } .ds-chip { display: inline-block; padding: 1px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--dn-card-sky-bg); color: var(--dn-card-sky-text); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 18px; }

components.name: Board Tile
components.description: A nested board on the canvas; the tile tilts with a small overshoot on hover (a dog moment).
components.css: .ds-board { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 8px 4px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; color: var(--dn-text); font: 600 14px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-board-tile { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 60px; height: 60px; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--dn-card-peach-bg); color: var(--dn-card-peach-text); transition: transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.3, 1.6, 0.6, 1); } .ds-board:hover .ds-board-tile { transform: translateY(-2px) rotate(-3deg); } .ds-board:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--dn-selection); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Menu
components.description: Floating shelf menu with 36px rows and right-aligned shortcut hints.
components.css: .ds-menu { width: 200px; padding: 4px; background: var(--dn-panel); border: 1px solid var(--dn-border); border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.25); } .ds-menu-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--dn-text); font: 13px/20px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-menu-item:hover { background: var(--dn-card-hover); } .ds-menu-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--dn-selection); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-menu-item kbd { margin-left: auto; color: var(--dn-text-muted); font: inherit; font-size: 12px; } .ds-menu-sep { height: 1px; margin: 4px 6px; background: var(--dn-border); }

components.name: Selection Bar
components.description: Floats above the selection with colour swatches and actions; pops in over 140ms.
components.css: .ds-selbar { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px; background: var(--dn-panel); border: 1px solid var(--dn-border); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.25); font: 13px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-swatch { width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--dn-panel), 0 0 0 3.5px var(--dn-border); } .ds-swatch-on { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--dn-panel), 0 0 0 3.5px var(--dn-selection); } .ds-selbar-sep { width: 1px; height: 20px; background: var(--dn-border); } .ds-selbar-btn { min-height: 32px; padding: 0 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--dn-text-muted); font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-selbar-btn:hover { background: var(--dn-card-hover); color: var(--dn-text); }

components.name: Toast
components.description: Bottom-centre confirmation in dog copy, with an optional action.
components.css: .ds-toast { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--dn-border); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--dn-panel); color: var(--dn-text); font: 14px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-toast-action { padding: 4px 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--dn-accent); font: 600 13px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-toast-action:hover { background: var(--dn-card-hover); }

narrative.overview:
Creative North Star: "The Warm Den"

DoggyNote is a lamp-lit room where your things are spread out on the floor. The canvas is the floor: warm, dark, dotted, and quiet. The cards are what you brought in. The chrome around them is furniture you stop noticing, set in the same warm browns as the room. One golden light, Retriever Gold, marks where your attention is: the selected card, the active tool, the one button that moves you forward.

The den is dark by default and has a daytime twin in oat and milk tones. Both are tuned together. Every colour has a value in each theme, and contrast is enforced by test, not taste. Density is calm rather than sparse. Controls are compact (13px labels, 32px icon buttons), so the board gets the space.

Personality lives in small, specific dog moments rather than decoration. A board tile tilts when you hover it. The login logo leans at an angle. A dragged tool's ghost is slightly askew. Stickers wear a white die-cut border. The pan cursor is a paw. Everything else is plain. The den rejects the cool-grey, blue-button sterility of corporate SaaS, and it rejects frosted glass, neon glows and purple-blue gradients.
keyCharacteristics: Warm brown neutrals throughout; no cool greys anywhere.
One amber accent per theme, used sparingly for selection, focus and the primary action.
Dark-first, with a fully tuned light twin.
Flat canvas; only floating tools and lifted cards cast shadows.
System font, small sizes, firm weights (600 for emphasis).
Dog personality comes from motion, tilt and copy, never from ornament.

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: Retriever Gold is the only accent. It appears where attention belongs (selection, focus, the single primary action, the active tool) and nowhere decorative. If a screen has two gold buttons, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Twin Rule
rules.body: No colour exists in one theme only. Every new token gets a dark and a light value in `tokens.ts` and passes `theme.test.ts`: 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for the selection outline.

rules.name: The No Hex Rule
rules.body: Components never contain a hex value. They read `var(--dn-*)`. Canvas drawing code reads `surfaces[theme()]`.

rules.name: The 600 Rule
rules.body: Emphasis is weight 600: the current breadcrumb, column titles, board titles, primary buttons. Reach for 700 only for the entry headline. Never use colour alone for emphasis.

rules.name: The Measured Card Rule
rules.body: Never change font size or padding inside a card for touch or any other mode. Card heights are measured and synced, so a size change on one device moves cards for everyone. Enlarge the targets outside the card instead.

rules.name: The Flat Floor Rule
rules.body: Content on the canvas never casts a shadow at rest. Shadows mean "this is floating above the board" or "you're holding this".

dos: Do take every colour from `var(--dn-*)`, and add new ones to `tokens.ts` with both a dark and a light value.
Do keep Retriever Gold for selection, focus, the active tool and a single primary action per view.
Do use weight 600 for emphasis and keep app chrome at 11–14px.
Do keep the canvas flat. Give shadows only to floating UI and the card being dragged.
Do put dog personality in copy (`COPY` in `packages/theme/src/copy.ts`), small tilts, the paw cursor and stickers.
Do gate hover styles behind `html[data-input="mouse"]`, and give touch targets 44px hit areas outside the card.
Do use calm ease-out at 120–200ms for UI, and save overshoot for dog moments.
donts: Don't hard-code hex values in components, or add a colour that exists in one theme only.
Don't introduce cool greys, blue primary buttons or other corporate SaaS sterility.
Don't use frosted glass, neon glows, or purple-blue gradients.
Don't add a second accent colour or put gold on decoration.
Don't put springy overshoot on functional transitions such as sheets, menus, toasts or the docked selection bar. Those use `cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`.
Don't change text size or padding inside cards for any input mode. Heights are measured and synced.
Don't give cards a per-card `transform`, or shadows at rest.
